core_claim: A volunteer-collected ledger of 178,749 repair attempts shows that whether a broken object can be saved is mostly a property of its design, not of effort or skill — and 26 rows in 2023-2026 quietly mark the entry of generative AI into the global repair-cafe toolkit.
